records.verbatim_quote: The paper reports a word-level Penn Treebank test perplexity of 57.3 for AWD-LSTM, a 3-layer LSTM with tied weights, as a single model without cache/pointer.
records.notes: Note states this result includes the fine-tuning step.

records.verbatim_quote: It also reports 65.8 on WikiText-2. This result includes the fine-tuning step.
records.notes: WikiText-2 result; note says it includes fine-tuning.

records.verbatim_quote: Table 4 lists the no-fine-tuning ablation at 58.8 test perplexity on Penn Treebank, and the paper states that removal of the fine-tuning step degrades performance.
For the proposed model augmented with a continuous cache pointer, the paper reports an even lower Penn Treebank test perplexity of 52.8 and 52.0 on WikiText-2.
records.notes: Cache pointer variant; note says fine-tuning is part of the training procedure.

records.verbatim_quote: For the proposed model augmented with a continuous cache pointer, the paper reports an even lower Penn Treebank test perplexity of 52.8 and 52.0 on WikiText-2.
